Switches dithering on or off, which hides banding in gradients. With Dither on, the picture in the window gets Interleaved Gradient Noise of up to half a step of the 8 bit output added when it is shown, so that the bands that rounding makes (for instance after SetGamma and UpdateGamma changed a gradient to values in between two steps) become a fine pattern that the eye averages out. The noise is made on the GPU while the picture is shown, costs one pass over the screen, and does not change the buffers: ReadPixel and SaveBuffer see what was drawn. A color that the picture can show exactly stays as it is.
@param enable  True to dither, False not to. It is off by default, and unlike in the original it does not matter which color depth was asked for.
